title: C78 attribution of original C76 clear-region errors

official_C76.scope: complete official fixed validation,2330maps/band; not hidden test
official_C76.scorer: Reused previously verified unmodified official score_submission.py and metrics.py

protocol.parent: C76 frozen 50% C72 local + 50% C73 real graph
protocol.partitions: Internal official-TRAIN experiment: original 128 terrains (all TXs) calibrate diagnostic coefficients, other 484 terrains confirm once. Uniform sample of 2048 pixels without replacement per map, fixed independently of targets. Full published VAL is a separate frozen-deployment descriptive check only, after the internal training decision; no VAL calibration or model selection.
protocol.outcomes: Per-band masked global RMSE, share of all originally-clear SSE and pixels, rates and shares for absolute errors >=3 and >=5 dB, signed bias (true minus prediction). Complementary bands use their own masks; paired-band summaries use joint mask. Group uncertainty by terrain.
protocol.geometry: Original clear = C76 compact channel 16 > .99 (weighted 9 area samples per receiver triangle). On the identical pixels vary only area sampling, triangle diagonal, TX z convention, TX/RX height and half-pixel TX offsets. Primary switch = any physically bracketed alternative drops below .90. Report arbitrary stricter >=.99 separately. Coarsened DTM is stress only. Prove a conservative subset clear for every point of every supported triangle via swept ray boxes and terrain-height upper bounds. Distinguish failure to certify from an observed visibility flip.
protocol.radiometry: Total pathloss is observed, per-path truth is unavailable. Compute geometric direct reference and the weakest free-space direct power allowed by the bracket; partition observed power above/below direct bounds with 1/3/6 dB margins. A deficit is evidence against an intact continuum direct component with only additive nonnegative multipath, not proof of geometric occlusion. Split visibility uncertainty from additive specular/diffuse power. Compare no extra power, specular only, diffuse only and both; compare high-resolution one-bounce estimates and source-weighted diffuse integration. Cross-frequency common/difference errors and physically matched shuffles are controls.
protocol.diagnostic_fit: Fit only small fixed linear diagnostic corrections on the calibration terrain set. Always apply the frozen coefficients to distinct confirmation terrains. Geometry-only and power-only incremental controls share the same original point set; true-vs-shuffled label-free features test conditional spatial pairing. A label-derived subgroup is diagnostic, never an inference input.
protocol.training_gate: Run a further neural training candidate only if a deployable diagnostic improves original-clear RMSE by at least 0.15 dB and full-map RMSE by 0.08 dB in BOTH bands on the 484 confirmation terrains, with positive paired 95% lower bounds on full-map gains and at least 0.05 dB clear incremental gain over the matched control from a specific physical family. Claimed major version still requires 0.30 dB in both bands vs C76; target remains each official VAL RMSE <=1 dB.
protocol.approved: Compute on physical 1/3/4 only under run_gpu.sh full UUID guard. No website submission. Raw data only from top-level release. No official VAL updates.

decision.reason: No prespecified input-only correction approaches either minimum effect size on the 484 internal confirmation terrains. No requirement for official labels to make this decision.
